metadata.title: Curative Title + Creative Finance: The Combo Most Investors Miss
metadata.author: Courtney Fricke
metadata.shortDescription:
Most investors treat Curative title work and creative finance as two completely separate skill sets.

That is a mistake.

In this episode, Courtney Fricke and Ellis San Jose break down how combining Curative strategy with creative deal structuring can dramatically reduce risk, lower cash outlay, enhance returns, and create opportunities most investors never even see.

If you operate in messy estates, multiple-heir situations, liens, judgments, or stalled transactions, this conversation will expand your toolbox.

ATTENTION:
The information shared in this episode is for educational and informational purposes only and reflects personal experiences and opinions. It is not intended as legal, tax, financial, or investment advice. Real Estate laws, tax rules, and regulations vary by state and situation. Always consult with a qualified attorney, CPA, or other licensed professional before making any Real Estate or financial decisions.
